cn.t: Williams' tech-heavy adaptation of Genet's classic divides critics: some praise the visually dazzling "cine-theatre" aesthetic as inventive and thrilling, while others dismiss it as slick but shallow showmanship that overshadows the text.

vr.q: Although I enjoyed it in the moment, I can tell it won't stick with me because it was ultimately more interesting than it was affecting.
